items.title: What Is Visa (V) Doing With Stablecoin Payments In Europe And Asia?
items.summary: Visa (NYSE: V) is expanding stablecoin-based payment options through new partnerships with Norwegian Block Exchange and Triple-A in 2026. The planned NBX Visa Flex Card will let customers settle payments in fiat or supported stablecoins across multiple European markets. Visa's collaboration with Triple-A aims to use stablecoins for cross-border Visa Direct payouts in Asia Pacific outside regular banking hours.
